event_name: State of Brews - NT & ACT (Capital, Bentspoke, Alice Springs, Beaver Brewing)
date_text: Fri, Oct 16th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Fri, Oct 16th • 11:00 PM AEDT
description: Including the Opening Night of the Sweeneys Beer Week Olympics 2026 - Timed Cup Stack, Cash Prize and Finalist Sunday BIG Prize! STATE OF BREWS: ACT + NT 🍺🏆 Sydney Beer Week 2026 starts HERE. On Friday 16 October, we're kicking off ten massive days of Sydney Beer Week at Hotel Sweeney's with State of Brews, and this year we're turning our attention to two parts of Australia that don't always get enough love on Sydney taps: THE ACT + NORTHERN TERRITORY We're currently busy hunting down some of the most interesting beers we can find from breweries across both territories and working out how the hell we're going to get them all to Sydney. Fingers crossed fuel prices, freight costs and the considerable distance between Sydney and Darwin don't ruin our fun. We're trying our very best. 😂 What we can promise is a lineup designed to give you a taste of what's brewing beyond NSW, with some interesting beers, breweries you may not see every day and a few great reasons to start exploring from lunchtime. The beers hit the taps from lunch. And then at 5pm, things start getting competitive… 🏅 THE SWEENEY'S BEER WEEK OLYMPICS 2026 It's Opening Night, which means it's also Night One of the inaugural Sweeney's Beer Week Olympics. Every night throughout Beer Week, we'll be throwing down a different ridiculous pub challenge. Win your night and you'll take home some cash — and earn your place in the Grand Final. And we're starting with a classic: 🥤 THE 10-CUP STACK 10 cups. Out and back. Against the clock. Stack them up. Stack them back down. Fastest time wins. The competition runs from 5pm until 9pm, so you've got four hours to put down the fastest time of the night. Entry is just $2, and that gets you a couple of shots at glory. 🎡 EVERY ENTRY GETS A SPIN Your $2 gets you into the Cup Stack competition — but every single person who enters also gets a guaranteed spin of the Sweeney's Chocolate Wheel. On the wheel? 🍺 Complimentary middies 🥔 Packets of chips 🎡 Free spins 🤝 Handshakes 🤗 Hugs ✋ High fives 🎁 Prizes and plenty of other ridiculous stuff Absolutely destroy the Cup Stack? Spin the wheel. Completely bottle it and send ten cups flying across the pub? Spin the wheel anyway. Everybody gets their shot. 💰 FASTEST STACK TAKES THE LOT Every $2 entry goes into the night's prize pool. At 9pm, we'll find out who's sitting at the top of the leaderboard. Fastest time wins. Winner takes all. There's just one catch: You've got to be at Sweeney's at the end to claim it. So put down your time, grab yourself an ACT or NT beer, enjoy the rooftop and hang around to see whether anyone can knock you off. Because winning the cash is only the beginning… 🌽 THE $1,000 GRAND FINAL The Cup Stack champion becomes our first finalist in the Sweeney's Beer Week Olympics Grand Final. You'll return to Hotel Sweeney's at 2pm on Sunday 25 October — the closing day of Sydney Beer Week — to face the other nightly champions. And the Grand Final event? CORNHOLE. Win that and you'll walk away with the ultimate prize: A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY'S BAR TAB! 🏆🍺 So, let's recap Opening Friday… ACT + NT beers pouring from lunchtime. Sydney Beer Week officially underway. Cup Stack from 5–9pm. $2 entry. Winner-takes-all cash prize. A Chocolate Wheel spin for every entrant. Ridiculous prizes. And the first spot in Sunday's $1,000 Grand Final up for grabs. It's the first night of Sydney Beer Week 2026. We're starting as we mean to continue. Great beer. Ridiculous games. Plenty of laughs. And a whole lot of Sweeney's. What a Friday. See you on the rooftop. 🍺

event_name: New South Wales Amateur Homebrewers Association & Sydney Beer Week Pro- Am
date_text: Sat, Oct 17th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sat, Oct 17th • 5:00 PM AEDT
description: Including Night 2 of the Sweeneys Beer Week Olympics 2026 - Coin Slide Comp, Cash Prize and Finalist Sunday BIG Prize! THE PRO-AM 2026 – THE FINAL SHOWDOWN 🍺🏆 The homebrewers have brewed. The judges have judged. The breweries have fired up the big kit. Now there's only one thing left to do… Drink the beers and crown a champion. Hotel Sweeney's is incredibly proud to host the final leg of the Sydney Beer Week Pro-Am Competition 2026, with the final 12 beers hitting the taps for one massive afternoon at Sweeney's. The Pro-Am is a two-leg competition that takes a beer from the homebrew setup all the way to the commercial brewhouse. It starts with the New South Wales Amateur Homebrewers Association, who judge the homebrew competition and select the finalists. Those finalists then head to commercial breweries, where they get the opportunity to take their recipes, scale them up and brew them commercially. And that's where Sweeney's comes in. 🍺 12 FINALISTS. 12 BEERS. YOU DECIDE THE WINNER. All 12 Pro-Am beers will be pouring side by side at Hotel Sweeney's, giving you the chance to taste your way through the finalists and decide which one deserves ultimate glory. And this time, the judging is up to you. Taste the beers. Pick your favourite. Cast your vote anonymously by dropping it into the voting jar. No judges. No scoresheets. No overthinking it. Just vote for the beer you loved the most. At the end of the event, we'll count the votes and reveal the 2026 Pro-Am Champion. Bragging rights. Glory. And the right to say you brewed the best beer in the competition. 🏅 AND THAT'S ONLY HALF THE FUN… Because we're also rolling into Night Two of the Sweeney's Beer Week Olympics 2026! From 2pm–7pm, we're bringing you: 🪙 THE COIN SLIDE For a $2 donation, you get your shot at the night's Olympic challenge. Slide your coin down the table and get it as close to the edge as possible without sending it over. And those $2 entries aren't disappearing into the ether. The night's Coin Slide winner takes the entire entry pool. Winner takes all. But that's not all your $2 gets you… 🎡 EVERY ENTRY GETS A SPIN! Every single person who donates $2 gets a guaranteed spin of the Sweeney's Chocolate Wheel. It doesn't matter whether your Coin Slide is magnificent or your coin flies straight off the table and onto the floor — you still get to spin. And the wheel could land you all sorts of glory: Complimentary middys. Packets of chips. Free spins. Handshakes. Hugs. And plenty of other ridiculous prizes and surprises. So your $2 gets you into the Coin Slide, gives you the chance to take home the night's cash prize AND guarantees you a spin of the Chocolate Wheel. And if you win the Coin Slide, there's one more prize waiting… 🏆 THE $1,000 GRAND FINAL The Coin Slide champion qualifies for the Sweeney's Beer Week Olympics Grand Final on Sunday. Come back to Hotel Sweeney's and you'll go head-to-head with the other nightly champions in the ultimate final: 🌽 CORNHOLE. Win the final and you'll walk away with a massive: $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY'S BAR TAB! 🌭 AND DID SOMEONE SAY FREE SAUSAGE SIZZLE? Yep. We'll be firing up the BBQ with a FREE sausage sizzle for the first 200 people — or until they're gone. So get in early. Grab a sausage. Taste 12 completely unique Pro-Am beers. Vote for your champion. Throw $2 into the Olympics. Slide a coin. Spin the Chocolate Wheel. Win some stuff. Stay for the results. And maybe earn yourself a shot at $1,000 worth of glory on Sunday. 12 Pro-Am beers. 12 homebrewers and brewery collaborations. One people's-choice champion. Coin Slide. Chocolate Wheel. Cash prizes. Free sausage sizzle. And a pathway to a $1,000 Grand Final. There's a LOT going on. You'd be mad to miss it. It's going to be a cracking day at Hotel Sweeney's. 🍺🏆

event_name: ALTITUDE BREWING NZ TAKES OVER SWEENEY'S
date_text: Mon, Oct 19th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Mon, Oct 19th • 11:00 PM AEDT
description: Including Night 4 of the Sweeneys Beer Week Olympics 2026 - Darts Comp, 9 Darts - Highest Score, Cash Prize and Finalist Sunday BIG Prize! ALTITUDE BREWING NZ TAKES OVER SWEENEY'S🍺🏆 So let's see… Award-winning New Zealand beer making its Australian debut. Altitude Brewing on the Sweeney's rooftop. Nine-dart challenge. $2 entry. Winner-takes-all cash. A Chocolate Wheel spin for every entrant. Merch and ridiculous prizes. And a pathway to a $1,000 Grand Final. All on a Monday. Not bad for the start of the working week. Come and discover Altitude Brewing. Throw some darts. Spin the wheel. Win some stuff. Drink some genuinely brilliant beer. It's going to be an absolute belter of a night at Hotel Sweeney's.🍺🎯 One competition. All our Beer Week Olympics finalists. A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY'S BAR TAB! 🏆🍺And one massive prize: From 5pm–9pm, you've got nine darts to put together the biggest score you possibly can. That's it. No complicated rules. No excuses. Nine darts. Highest score wins. Entry is just $2, with every entry going into the night's cash prize pool. And whether you hit nine bullseyes or somehow manage to score absolutely nothing… 🎡 EVERYONE GETS TO SPIN THE WHEEL. Every single person who enters gets a guaranteed spin of the Sweeney's Chocolate Wheel. What's waiting on there? 🍺 Complimentary middies 👕 Brewery merch 🥔 Packets of chips 🎡 Free spins 🤝 Handshakes 🤗 Hugs ✋ High fives 🎁 And whatever other ridiculous things we decide to put on there Everyone who enters gets a spin and everyone gets the chance to win something. And we've got Altitude's Australian beer supplier John joining us on the rooftop, helping spin the wheel, handing out merch and getting amongst the fun. 💰 9PM. WINNER TAKES ALL. At 9pm, we'll check the leaderboard. Highest nine-dart score takes the entire $2 entry pool. Winner takes all. There's just one catch: You've got to be at Sweeney's at the end to claim it. But the cash isn't the only thing you're playing for. Our darts champion also earns a spot in the Sweeney's Beer Week Olympics Grand Final. 🌽 SUNDAY 25 OCTOBER — THE $1,000 FINAL Come back to Hotel Sweeney's on the closing Sunday of Sydney Beer Week and you'll face the other nightly champions in our final event: New Zealand is coming to the Sweeney's rooftop — and they're bringing some serious hardware with them. On Monday of Sydney Beer Week, we're incredibly excited to welcome Altitude Brewing from Queenstown, New Zealand, with their beers pouring at Hotel Sweeney's for the first time in Australia. And this isn't just any brewery making the trip across the ditch. Altitude were crowned Champion Small International Brewery at the Australian International Beer Awards in BOTH 2025 and 2026, and backed that up by taking out Champion Medium Brewery at the 2025 New Zealand Beer Awards. In 2026, they also picked up trophies for Best Pilsner and Best Modern Pale Ale, with an extraordinary 20 medals from 20 beers entered at the AIBAs. So yeah… These guys know how to make beer. Unless you've been lucky enough to visit them in New Zealand, there's a pretty good chance you haven't had the opportunity to try these beers before. Now you don't need a plane ticket. We're bringing Altitude to Sydney. Expect a cracking lineup from one of New Zealand's most exciting breweries, pouring on the rooftop for what should be something genuinely special for Sydney Beer Week 2026. And because apparently great beer isn't enough… 🎯 NIGHT FOUR OF THE SWEENEY'S BEER WEEK OLYMPICS Monday also brings us Night Four of the Sweeney's Beer Week Olympics 2026. 🎯 NINE DARTS. HIGHEST SCORE WINS.And tonight we're heading to the dartboard.

date_text: Wed, Oct 21st • 12:00 PM AEDT - Wed, Oct 21st • 11:00 PM AEDT
description: Night 6 of the Sweeneys Beer Week Olympics 2026 - Foosball Comp, Cash Prize and Finalist Sunday BIG Prize! Rocky Ridge are back in the house for the return of Sweeney’s Annual Foosball Comp! We kicked this one off last year and, quite frankly, things got competitive. At various points the foosball table was practically coming off the rooftop floor as players battled it out for bragging rights and the grand prize. This year we’re doing it all again — but with a Beer Week Olympics twist. 🏓 FOOSBALL COMP | 5PM–9PM It’s player vs player. Get your name on the board, keep winning and keep your spot. At the end of the night, the ultimate winner takes the cash prize — winner takes all! 🏅 NIGHT SIX OF THE SWEENEY’S BEER WEEK OLYMPICS Win the foosball and you’ll also qualify for the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics Grand Final on Sunday — our rooftop Cornhole Comp — where you’ll have the chance to take home a massive $1,000 Sweeney’s bar tab. 🎡 $2 ENTRY = A SPIN OF THE WHEEL Everyone who enters the comp gets a spin of the Rocky Ridge chocolate wheel, with prizes including complimentary middies, Rocky Ridge merch, packets of chips, free spins, handshakes and whatever else we can rustle up on the night. 🍺 ROCKY RIDGE IN THE HOUSE James will be joining us on the rooftop, spinning the wheel, talking beer and generally keeping the chaos moving, with some cracking Rocky Ridge beers pouring across the taps. 👕 And yes, there’ll be merch. Rocky Ridge always bring the merch. Wednesday | 5PM–9PM | Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop $2 to enter the Foosball Comp | Winner takes the nightly cash prize Come for a beer. Have a spin. Get on the table. Keep winning. And you could find yourself back on Sunday playing for $1,000 in the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics Grand Final.

event_name: KAIJU! vs Hop Nation – The (not beer) Pong Challenge!
date_text: Thu, Oct 22nd • 12:00 PM AEDT - Thu, Oct 22nd • 11:00 PM AEDT
description: Night 7 of the Sweeneys Beer Week Olympics 2026 - (not beer) Pong Challenge, Cash Prize and Finalist Sunday BIG Prize! KAIJU! and Hop Nation. Head-to-head. Rooftop. Pong. Let’s go. Thursday night of Sydney Beer Week sees two absolute weapons of Australian craft beer taking over the Hotel Sweeney’s rooftop for Night Seven of the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics — and this time, we’re playing THE PONG CHALLENGE. 🏓 10 CUPS. INFINITE BALLS. 60 SECONDS. The rules are beautifully simple. One bounce on the table. Into the cup. Repeat. You’ve got ONE MINUTE and an infinite supply of balls to sink as many as humanly possible into 10 cups. Sink the most? Your name goes on the board. Then the entire rooftop gets the chance to knock you off. Think you’ve got better hands? Prove it. 💰 $2 IN. WINNER TAKES ALL. Every challenge costs just $2. We kick off at 5PM, and every $2 entry goes into the prize pool. If your name is still sitting at the top of the leaderboard when the clock hits 9PM, congratulations — YOU TAKE THE LOT. 🎡 EVERY PLAYER SPINS THE WHEEL Sink ten. Sink one. Sink absolutely nothing. Doesn’t matter. Your $2 entry guarantees you a spin of the wheel, where you could walk away with KAIJU! and Hop Nation merch, complimentary middies of cracking beer, packets of chips, free spins, high fives from the boys and whatever other ridiculous prizes we manage to rustle up. 🍺 KAIJU! vs HOP NATION ON THE TAPS Two breweries. One rooftop. Plenty of excellent beer. We’ll have beers from KAIJU! and Hop Nation pouring across the rooftop taps, with the crews in the house to join the fun, spin the wheel and see who can actually handle the pressure. 🏆 AND THEN THERE’S SUNDAY… Winning Thursday isn't just about taking home the cash. You'll also earn your spot in the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics Grand Final on Sunday — a sudden-death rooftop Cornhole Comp where the weekly champions battle it out for the ultimate prize: A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY’S BAR TAB. Thursday | From 5PM | Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop $2 per Pong Challenge | Winner Takes All | Grand Final Qualification Friday is basically here anyway. Get down to the rooftop. Grab a beer. Throw some balls. Spin the wheel. Take the cash. Make a weekend of it. LET’S GO.

date_text: Fri, Oct 23rd • 12:00 PM AEDT - Fri, Oct 23rd • 11:00 PM AEDT
description: Including Night 8 of the Sweeneys Beer Week Olympics 2026 - Coaster Flip Challenge, Cash Prize and Finalist Sunday BIG Prize! The crew from Aether Brewing are heading down from Queensland and they’re not coming empty-handed. They’ve been busy collaborating with breweries from all around Australia, creating a lineup of special, one-off collaboration beers — and on Friday night, they’re bringing the lot to Hotel Sweeney’s rooftop. Never-before-seen beers. One rooftop. The Aether lads in the house. And because this is Sweeney’s during Beer Week, obviously we’re turning it into a competition. 🍺 AETHER & FRIENDS – COLLABORATION TAP TAKEOVER Aether are bringing the goods, with a stack of one-off collaboration beers created with breweries from around Australia, all pouring across the Sweeney’s rooftop taps. The Aether crew will be there to talk beer, have a yarn, spin the chocolate wheel and enjoy the Friday night chaos. 🃏 THE CLASSIC SWEENEY’S COASTER FLIP It’s another night of the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics, and Friday brings back an absolute classic. The rules? Start with ONE coaster. Place it on the edge of the table. Flick it into the air with the back of your hand. Catch it before it hits the table. Got it? Add another. One becomes two. Two becomes three. Three becomes four… You’ve got TWO MINUTES to work your way up and successfully catch as many coasters as you possibly can. Highest successful coaster catch? YOUR NAME GOES ON THE BOARD. And then everyone else on the rooftop gets their chance to knock you off. 💰 $2 IN. WINNER TAKES ALL. Every attempt costs just $2, and every gold coin goes into the prize pool. We’re flipping from 5PM until 9PM. If your name is still sitting at the top of the board at 9PM? YOU TAKE THE LOT. 🎡 CAN’T CATCH A COASTER? YOU STILL GET A SPIN. Lightning reactions? Brilliant. Hands like concrete and you don't catch a thing? Also fine. Every $2 entry guarantees you a spin of the Aether chocolate wheel, with the chance to win complimentary middies, Aether merch, free spins, handshakes, high fives, maybe a packet of chips and whatever else the lads manage to find. 🏆 WIN FRIDAY. COME BACK SUNDAY. PLAY FOR $1,000. If you finish Friday night as our Coaster Flip champion, the cash isn't the end of it. You’ll also qualify for the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics Grand Final on Sunday. The weekly champions return to the rooftop for a sudden-death Cornhole Comp, with one enormous prize waiting for the last person standing: A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY’S BAR TAB. It’s Friday night. Drink beers nobody’s had before. Flip some coasters. Spin the wheel. Win some cash. Come back Sunday and have a crack at $1,000. What’s not to love? GET AMONGST IT. LET’S GO!

event_name: TWØBAYS: The Gluten-Free Rooftop Takeover | Beer Week Grand Final
date_text: Sun, Oct 25th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Oct 25th • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: THE FINAL DAY. 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE BEER. $1,000 ON THE LINE. LET’S FINISH SYDNEY BEER WEEK PROPERLY. For the final day of Sydney Beer Week, Hotel Sweeney’s is throwing open the rooftop taps to our mates from Melbourne — TWØBAYS Brewing Co. And when we say takeover, we mean it. 🍺 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE. That’s right — all 12 rooftop taps pouring gluten-free beer from TWØBAYS. Their last takeover at Sweeney’s saw kegs popping on the same day, and year after year this remains one of our most talked-about events — bringing together the gluten-free and coeliac community for something that can be pretty hard to find: A rooftop pub with an entire tap lineup of gluten-free beer. And this year, we’re going even bigger. With TWØBAYS opening their new Melbourne bar, we’ll have access to some of their exclusive taproom-only beers, making their way north to Sweeney’s especially for Sydney Beer Week. 🌞 ROOFTOP OPEN FROM 10AM Why wait until lunch? For the final day of Beer Week, we’re opening the Sweeney’s rooftop from 10AM, giving you plenty of time to grab a spot, work your way through the taps and settle in for the day. 🍽️ GLUTEN-FREE BEER. GLUTEN-FREE FOOD. The kitchen will be open with gluten-free meals available to order alongside your beers. Come hungry. Come thirsty. Make a day of it. 🏆 THE SWEENEY’S BEER WEEK OLYMPICS GRAND FINAL Then at 2PM, things get serious. After nine nights of ridiculous challenges, gold coins, chocolate wheels, questionable sporting ability and glorious victories, our nightly champions return to Hotel Sweeney’s for one final showdown. THE CORNHOLE GRAND FINAL. Nine nights. Nine winners. One sudden-death competition. One champion. And one enormous prize: A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY’S BAR TAB. Our finalists will need their beanbags ready and their finest wrist action dialled in, because when you’re out, you’re out. Last person standing takes the lot. 🌾 COELIAC? GLUTEN-FREE? OR JUST LOVE GREAT BEER? This is your day. TWØBAYS always brings an incredible crowd to Sweeney’s, and whether you’re coeliac, gluten-aware, bringing along someone who is, or simply keen to try some cracking Australian beer, everyone is welcome on the rooftop. Sydney Beer Week has given us nine massive nights. Now there’s only one thing left to do. Fill the taps. Fill the rooftop. Throw some beanbags. Crown a champion. 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE. $1,000 UP FOR GRABS. ONE LAST SUNDAY. LET’S GO!
